parameters.formDescription: Please complete this so we have everything we need to run your show.

values.fieldLabel: Band / Group Name
Venue
Show Date
Performer Contact — best day-of cell phone

values.html: Best point of contact from the group. Please text or call this person when you are about 5 minutes out, and introduce yourself onsite as soon as you arrive.
Please provide a current stage plot / input list. Upload accepts PDF, image, Word, or Excel. No file handy? Use the description box below instead, or paste a shareable link.

values.fieldLabel: Stage Plot / Input List — upload (optional)
Stage Plot / Input List — description or link (optional)
Would you prefer a flat stage or a drum riser?
How many monitors do you need?
Are you bringing your own in-ears (IEMs)?
If bringing your own in-ears — are you providing a split snake?

values.option: N/A — not bringing our own in-ears

values.fieldLabel: Backline / Instrumentation — are you sharing with another artist on the event?

values.html: Artists provide all instruments, including amps and 1/4-inch cables. If you have coordinated to share backline with another artist on the event, note it above.

values.fieldLabel: Are you bringing your own sound engineer?

values.html: We provide audio engineers to mix FOH and monitors. If you plan to bring your own, please coordinate in advance. All engineers must mix within the 95 dB ordinance; the FSQ engineer reserves the right to baffle amps to reduce stage volume if necessary.

values.fieldLabel: Do you have a backdrop or any scenic elements we should be aware of?
Lighting requests

values.html: We provide a house LD. Let us know any specific requests and we will do our best to accommodate.

values.fieldLabel: Are you selling merch?

values.html: If yes, you are responsible for providing a seller, point of sale, and bank. We provide a tent next to the stage with a table and chairs.

values.fieldLabel: Do you want a private band tent? (10x10 w/ sidewalls)

values.html: We do not have indoor dressing rooms. On request we can provide a 10x10 tent with sidewalls for private band space.

values.fieldLabel: Total number of performers

values.html: Drink tickets and water are provided for all performers.

values.fieldLabel: Do you need large vehicle parking?

values.html: Includes any vehicle over 6 ft 8 in (the garage clearance), large vans, any vehicle with a trailer, and tour buses.

The load-in process at Fountain Square has changed — please review the document your contact sent. Each vehicle needs its own parking QR validation before arriving; scan at the kiosk on entry or exit (please do not pay).

values.fieldLabel: Load-in document — I have reviewed it

values.option: Yes, I have reviewed the load-in document

values.html: We are required by the city to maintain a strict 95 dB limit, measured at the FOH position. All engineers (house or talent) are held to that level.

values.fieldLabel: 95 dB sound limit — I acknowledge

values.option: I understand and acknowledge the 95 dB limit at FOH

values.html:
Failure to comply with the below may result in a warning or termination of the show, with payment canceled or delayed. Please read and acknowledge:

  • Content: Family-friendly only — no foul language or gestures. Applies to prerecorded tracks, live vocals, and sound check.
  • Sound limit: Strict 95 dB at FOH for all engineers, house or talent.
  • Performer safety: Stay on the stage. No crowd surfing, climbing, jumping off stage, or stepping on sound equipment.
  • Audience safety: Do not throw or shoot anything into the crowd (confetti, t-shirts, bottles, merch/CDs, etc.).
  • Weather: Rain or shine. Booking evaluates weather about 3 hours before start. If you do not hear otherwise, assume the show goes on.
  • Payment: All groups are paid after the performance, not before.

values.fieldLabel: Performance Requirements — I have read and acknowledge all of the above

values.option: I have read and acknowledge all performance requirements

values.fieldLabel: Additional questions or concerns?

options.formSubmittedText: Thanks — we've got your show details. Your booking contact will follow up if anything's missing.
